other_conditions: Applicants must be permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh
The scheme is open to marginal farmers who own or lease small areas of agricultural land suitable for kitchen gardening
Individuals from the general public interested in establishing a kitchen garden are also eligible
Applicants must have sufficient space within their premises to set up a kitchen garden
Eligible individuals should demonstrate commitment and capability to maintain and sustain the kitchen garden
benefits_summary: The scheme enables households to grow vegetables and rear livestock, improving nutrition, self‑sufficiency and generating additional income.
